Players Committee card image of [[Point Man (V) (Errata)]] (errata PC-E1), game text: “USED: Move a trooper as a 'react' to a battle where you have a leader. OR During any draw phase, place a card from hand under your Used Pile to take any one card into hand from Force Pile; reshuffle. LOST: During a battle at a site, cancel Keep Your Eyes Open.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual5-Dark/large/pointman.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/53572eb94d14c4f21f0f3396874727653397c6e8 53572eb] (16 August 2023). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is the latest version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the repository file is named .gif but is PNG data, so it is uploaded with a .png name).
